critical_code_review_comments: FloorOperatorDay only renders DeptMachines when the current role has a matching dept assignment (mine). If unassigned, DeptMachines never appears in operator mode — by design but could confuse users; consider a helper banner.

Machine-status voice announcement (point 4) waits on 30s polling of deptApi.assignment(); on first entry the TTS is fired only after 'mine' resolves. Consider immediate refresh on role change to reduce delay.
